title: judgment-ledger/v1
description: One append-only JSONL stream, two record kinds. Unknown fields are allowed and must be preserved by readers. Canonical copy: ~/.claude/tools/judgment/ledger-schema.json (rdfitted/Claude-Code-Setup#24). Other repos vendor it with a provenance header and hash check.

subject_ref.description: What was judged: run id + item key, session + milestone + criterion, ...

state_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical JSON of the state actually judged

state_ref.description: evidence/<decision_id>.json, relative to the ledger directory

question_version.description: sha256 of the exact instructions + criteria sent

model.description: Resolved model version as returned by the provider (e.g. jev-1.13.0), not the alias requested

sampling.description: null means UNKNOWN. The auditor reports unknown sampling as not comparable rather than assuming temperature 0.

answer.description: Any JSON value; null when the call failed (see error)

confidence.description: Choice/Score distribution concentration. Noul has none; do not confuse with the top probability.

routed.description: What the system did with this judgment: none | admitted | audit-sample | advisory-shown | tier-b | gated-*

error.description: Non-null means the judge failed and the caller fell back (fail-open)

source_decision_id.description: Shadow rows: the incumbent decision this row re-judges. Outcomes on the source apply to this row too.

label.description: Ground truth: the user's chosen disposition, an override verdict, a human label

source.description: Authority order when several outcomes exist: human-label > operator-override > user-answer > model-ack > downstream. model-ack = the model ticked what it found relevant (a self-report, cross-checked).
